name: plans-compare
description: Pricing v2 'Compare plans' section: centred heading and lead, a feature-by-plan table (grouped, indented rows; ticks, dashes or values), and an 'on every plan' pill list. On phones a plan switch shows one plan column at a time; a pick in plans-picker focuses that plan's column. Source: the Asset Panda Pricing v2 mockup.

section_id.description: Section id, so plan cards can link to #compare.

variant.description: classic: the mockup's banded table. clean: open table with plain section headings and round ticks.

plans.description: Table columns, in order. Each: name, price (the small purple line under the name), accent (clean variant column colour: slate, teal, indigo, violet, amber or rose).

featured_plan.description: Plan whose column is tinted top to bottom and tagged in its header (clean variant), e.g. Growth.

featured_label.description: Tag in the featured plan's header.

art.description: Illustration in the table header's empty top-left corner, standing on the header rule and (on wide screens) rising above the table's top edge (clean variant): a URL, or a file name in this component's assets folder, e.g. panda-ursa.webp.

art_alt.description: Alt text for the illustration. Empty marks it decorative.

art_width.description: Illustration's intrinsic width in px. 0 leaves it out.

rows.description: Table rows, in order. Each: label, hint (small grey line under the label), kind (top = bold row, group = section band, sub = indented row, sub2 = doubly indented), values (one per plan, separated by |; yes = tick, no = dash, anything else is shown as written).

focus_plan.description: Plan the phone switch shows first. Empty shows the first plan.

switch_label.description: Accessible name of the phone plan switch.

table_label.description: Accessible name of the scrollable table region.
